correctness.rationale: With 3|m, each J_m is square-zero rank-one over F_3; tensor-coordinate sum N=A+dI satisfies N³=0 by characteristic-three Frobenius. Tensor-sum Jordan fusion J2⊞J2=J3⊕J1 and J3⊞J2=2J3 yields a=((m-1)^d+(m-3)^d)/2, b=((m-1)^d-(m-3)^d)/2,c=(m^d-a-2b)/3; k1=a+b+c,k2=a+2b+2c. The temporal companion polynomial is (X²+dX+1)^j per j-block and the eigenkernel is one-dimensional, hence for d mod3=1,2 the temporal blocks are J_{2j}(+/-1), and for d mod3=0 the irreducible (X²+1)^j cyclic module. Fixed-space ranks give sharp orders 9,18,12 respectively and primitive populations by subtracting divisibility-ordered fixed counts; T is invertible so all initial states are periodic. Independent exact F_3 matrix ranks/orders matched m=3,d=1,2,3 and m=6,d=1. Finite matrix cases do not imply the all-d tensor identity without the algebraic proof.
